tree.heading: Field-based course
tree.text: The term “field-based course” means a course of instruction offered by an institution of higher education that includes a requirement that students teach a minimum of 3 lessons or sequences of lessons to elementary or secondary students.

tree.heading: Institution of higher education
tree.text: The term “institution of higher education” has the meaning given that term by section 1001 of this title.

tree.heading: Master teacher
tree.text: The term “master teacher” means an individual—

children.text: who has been awarded a master’s or doctoral degree by an institution of higher education;
whose graduate coursework included courses in mathematics, science, computer science, or engineering;
who has at least 3 years teaching experience in K–12 settings; and
whose teaching has been recognized for exceptional accomplishments in educating students, or is demonstrated to have resulted in improved student achievement.

tree.heading: Mentor teacher
tree.text: The term “mentor teacher” means an elementary or secondary school classroom teacher who assists with the training of students participating in a field-based course.

tree.heading: Director
tree.text: The term “Director” means the Director of the National Science Foundation.
